item.title: CVE-2026-136413 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | AppStream 0.14.5 before 1.2.3 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in asc_l10n_parse_data_qt() that allows attackers to hang compose runs by supplying unchecked tag lengths in Qt .qm files. Attackers can place a crafted .qm file with a 0xFFFFFFFB tag length, referenced by a component's qt translation element, to wrap the read offset and hang appstreamcli compose indefinitely.

item.title: CVE-2026-136414 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | AppStream 0.14.5 before 1.2.3 contains a division by zero vulnerability in asc_read_translation_status() in compose/asc-utils-l10n.c that allows attackers to crash compose runs via crafted Qt .qm files. Attackers can supply a valid .qm file with no TRANSLATION records, triggering SIGFPE that terminates the entire appstreamcli compose or libappstream-compose process.

item.title: CVE-2026-136421 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.0: 6.4
item.description:
Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.0: 6.4 | rocket.chat Server-Side Request Forgery Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of rocket.chat. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the web service, which listens on TCP port 3000 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a URI prior to accessing resources. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-29853.

item.title: CVE-2026-136422 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.0: 7.8
item.description:
Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.0: 7.8 | Soda PDF Desktop PDF File Parsing Memory Corruption Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Soda PDF Desktop. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.
The specific flaw exists within the parsing of PDF files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a memory corruption condition. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-31995.
